sentences.en: A leading specialist was brought in to authenticate the painting.
sentences.zh: 一位权威专家被请来鉴定这幅画。

sentences.en: My doctor suggested that I see a specialist in Boston.
sentences.zh: 我的医生建议我去波士顿看专科医生。

sentences.en: He enjoys a good reputation as a specialist in brain surgery.
sentences.zh: 他作为脑外科专家享有良好的声誉。
